neighbours.label: the word 'proper' / 'properly' (and 'practice') in advice about doing something the correct way
fire: Before lifting anything heavy, make sure you use proper form to protect your back.
Most garden problems can be avoided with proper watering and a little patience.
The guide explains how to store your fish properly so it stays fresh for days.
Good health depends on proper nutrition, enough sleep and regular exercise.
New climbers should learn the proper way to tie a figure-eight knot.
If the wound is cleaned properly, it should heal within a week or two.
Coaches remind runners that proper hydration matters even on cool mornings.
With proper care, a cast iron pan will last for several generations.
quiet: Before lifting anything heavy, make sure you keep your feet wide to protect your back.
Most garden problems can be avoided with regular watering and a little patience.
The guide explains how to store your fish in ice so it stays fresh for days.
Good health depends on varied meals, enough sleep and regular exercise.
New climbers should learn the quickest way to tie a figure-eight knot.
If the wound is kept dry and clean, it should heal within a week or two.

notes: card: ' Proper' x6, ' proper' x3, ' practice' x3, 'per' x2 in health/fitness tips. Quiet keeps the advice, swaps in other adjectives.
